verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Computer Use, which lets ChatGPT see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS or Windows. The docs give example uses such as testing desktop apps and iOS simulator flows, note that screenshots are covered by data controls, and position local Work and the desktop app ("use your computer") as ways to complete tasks on the user's own resources. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that Computer Use reliably operates arbitrary third-party apps to complete real work.
